pair: /blog/...guide/ (how much does an AI consultant cost in Lebanon)
cannibalization_check.verdict: HIGH RISK. Same SERP. Kept separate because an article slot exists (jonahtebaa #7 on both). Mitigate: guide title/H1 carries 'cost'+'guide'; service page has short price block linking to guide; guide has CTA linking to service page; no FAQ duplication (service page FAQ = engagement questions; guide FAQ = market questions).
Separate. Consulting SERP = directories+persons+firms; Solutions SERP = service catalogs (Seidor, Eurisko, Navybits, LB Clouds). Safe.
Interlink tier. Beirut SERP is community/person heavy (Beirut AI, meetups, 3 Wikipedia persons); About page carries the NAP/Beirut entity signals. Safe.
Google conflates the query with 'AI marketing agency'. Page will rank for its intended intent only via long-tail; primary value is conversion.
